title: Not all at once
hints: Instead of scheduling each item, start `limit` *workers*. Each worker is an async loop that keeps grabbing the next unprocessed index until none are left.
Share a `let next = 0` counter between the workers (a closure). JavaScript is single-threaded, so `const i = next++` can't race. Write each result to `results[i]` to keep the order.

const results = new Array<R>(items.length); let next = 0; const worker = async () => { while (next < items.length) { const i = next++; results[i] = await fn(items[i]); } }; await Promise.all(Array.from({ length: Math.min(limit, items.length) }, worker)); return results;
